Marissa / Ben — infra update and confirmed attachments: 

- rotation_logs_2027-2028.csv attached (exported). Contents: timestamp, key_id (redacted), rotation_type {auto, manual, emergency}, initiator_type {service_account, human_operator}, region, notes. We replaced operator emails with role tags (e.g., ops@redwood) for PII.
- HSM attestation request submitted to vendor; vendor provided attestation dated 2028-06-30 (FIPS 140-3 + vendor-signed attestation). Will store as hsm_attestation_202807.pdf when vendor confirms sharing rights.
- Short technical note (included inline below) on our key management model: 

==Technical Note (excerpt)==
Redwood uses a hybrid model: customer data keys (CDKs) are generated per-tenant within an AWS KMS-backed CMK. For dedicated/private customers who opt for BYOK, we support importing or wrapping a customer-supplied KEK that is never exported in plaintext. CMKs are backed by CloudHSM hardware keystores configured in FIPS mode.

Key rotation policy:
- KEKs (wrap keys): rotated per customer request or automatically every 90 days for Redwood-managed KEKs.
- CMKs (kek wrapping keys managed by KMS): scheduled rotation annually; rotation events trigger a re-wrap of CDKs and are logged in the rotation export.
- Emergency re-wraps: allowed with operator approval and logged as rotation_type=emergency.

Transport & at-rest: TLS 1.2+ with mutual auth for inter-service key transport; at-rest keys are stored wrapped under HSM-protected master keys and never persisted as plaintext on disk. Prefix/KV cache stores encrypted tokens only.

I verified logs do not contain plaintext key material. Redaction applied where needed.

Karthik
